title: ML-EAT: A Multilevel Embedding Association Test for Interpretable and Transparent Social Science
benchmark_measurement: Implicit bias associating religious groups (Christianity, Judaism, Islam) with pleasantness and unpleasantness.
findings: The paper's tests for religious bias, specifically associating Christianity, Judaism, and Islam (Arab-Muslims) with pleasantness or unpleasantness, did not yield statistically significant results in the tested CLIP models.
